description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'RatingStars' that visually represents a rating (0-5 stars) with icons, along with a count of ratings. It constructs a row of star icons based on the rating value, including half stars if applicable, and displays the count of ratings beside the icons.

classes.name: RatingStars
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that displays a star rating visual along with a count of total ratings.

methods.name: RatingStars
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget with rating value, count of ratings, and optional size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for display, rendering star icons and rating count.
